Hero_Desc_Sylla:
The coolest wind elemental in Elias.
She can sometimes be a bit cruel or overbearing.
She is kind of like a big sister to the elementals.
Album_Like_Sylla: High pressure in northwest Elias. A good balance among elementals.
Album_Hate_Sylla: Air turbulence. Dandelion seeds following her around.
Album_Wish_Sylla: Restoring the order as it was, when elementals were still respected.
Album_Sylla1: A wind elemental from Elias Forest. Sylla is reportedly the first to be born among the higher elementals, and may be why she is treated as an Elder sister among them.
Album_Sylla2: Perhaps it's because of her age, Sylla always behaves with dignity. I'm not sure if it's an attempt to set an example for other elementals or it really is her real personality. At times, she seems like... the crotchety neighbor next door.
Album_Sylla3: At first glance, the elementals may appear closed off, but that's just a facade. Sylla secretly enjoys riding the wind and roaming the outside world. Maybe it's because the wind's inherent nature is to freely wander?
Album_Sylla4: Since she is usually in wind form, she remains invisible to others, and is why she is privy to so many secrets from the denizens of Elias Forest. They say she's witnessed scenes she wishes she could unsee.
Album_Sylla5: Sylla may seem extremely conservative and stubborn from the outside, but upon closer inspection it seems she might be easily swayed. There was a time she said she hated the mint green tea ice cream that sprites gave her, only to change her tune when they insisted the ice cream was actually pretty good.
Album_Sylla6: Sylla is not very good at asserting her opinions. She's the type that has very little standards, taking what others say when she reaches a conclusion.
Album_Sylla7: Sometimes, I feel a bit sorry for Sylla. She has no clear sense of what she enjoys and easily gets swept up by others, just like how wind blows aimlessly without a clear destination.
LoveHero_Sylla:
If it's something I must handle
as a noble elemental,
I will.
LoveHeroCancel_Sylla:
Watch out for the wind's whimsy,
or you might get blown away!
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Hate1: Since this food reminded Sylla of phantoms just by looking at it, she pretended to be clumsy and knocked it off the table.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Hate2: Perhaps because the food was so highly processed and unrecognizable from its original state, Sylla frowned, refusing to eat it.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like1:
When Sylla saw that the cutlets were filled with nothing but warm air, she covered her mouth and looked at me plaintively.
I wasn't sure what she meant by that look.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like2: I was worried that Sylla wouldn't like it. Instead, she said she loved it, saying the food was in its natural state.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like3: Sylla sticks out her tongue and looks up at the sky, trying to eat the powder that flies away as soon as she touches it. I feel a little sorry for her.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like4: For some reason, Sylla suddenly decided to hoover the rice cakes, which then got stuck in her throat. She barely got it out.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like5: Sylla mentioned having seen werebeasts at the Elemental Mountain eating this snack. She casually tossed the powder from the bottle into her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like6: After pondering the food for a while... Sylla tried to swallow it in one big bite but struggled with a hard choke.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like7: Sylla seemed to think hardship had come her way. Tormented by the memory of choking on rice cakes, she simply stuck to licking the soup.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like8: Sylla was warned not to inhale the food. She put an Almond Praline in her mouth, chewed a bit, and got shocked when it disappeared.
Food_ChefNote_Sylla_Like9: Sylla was startled as the candy transformed into smoke the moment it hit her mouth. She praised the candy maker for being thoughtful.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Sylla: Wherever you may be, the wind blows.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Sylla:
Don't underestimate me,
the chief of the noble elementals.
Sylla_Spawn: Wherever you may be, the wind blows.
Sylla_Spawn1: Wherever you may be, the wind blows.
Sylla_Growth2: I shall grow stronger, as you wish.
Sylla_Victory1: This is the power of a noble elemental.
Sylla_Defeat2: Don't look at me! This is embarrassing!
Sylla_Affinity1_1: An arrow guided by the wind always hits its mark.
Sylla_Affinity1_2: Why so desperate to stab something?
Sylla_Affinity2: Crossing the sound barrier is the best feeling. It's like an explosion.

Sylla_Affinity4: Anyone is fine, as long as they're not a Phantom.

Sylla_Affinity6: Always go where the wind... my feet take me.
Sylla_Affinity7: Wind shouldn't "break", it should blow! Understood?
Sylla_Touch2: A touch as gentle as the mountain breeze.
Sylla_Touch2_2: There's something deeply familiar about this.
Sylla_DutchRubEnd2: Aren't you afraid of the consequences?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Sylla_Skin1: Sylla is enjoying archery as a hobby on a pleasant day. Thanks to her cutting-edge techwear, Sylla's arrows always hit the center of the target.
Sylla_Growth1_Skin1: Hmm, a perfect shot every time. How do I do it? Through effort, of course.
Sylla_Growth2_Skin1: I shall imbue my arrow with my wind!
Sylla_LevelUp_Skin1: Phew... Training is always fun. You can see the results of your training right away!
Sylla_Equipment_Skin1: Hmm... How will this help me?
Sylla_HeroSkill_Skin1: I can shoot a little farther now.
Sylla_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I'm going to be the best shooter in Elias!
Sylla_Board_Skin1: This way? Or that way? Where should I shoot? Just say the word!
Sylla_Touch1_Skin1: One shot... should I take it?
Sylla_Touch1_1_Skin1: Stop it. You're making it hard to aim!
Sylla_Touch1_2_Skin1: ...I'll let it slide this time. But next time... you know?
Sylla_Touch2_Skin1: Hmm... this might help honing my concentration.
Sylla_Touch2_1_Skin1: Be careful not to knock my hat off.
Sylla_Touch2_2_Skin1: I'm getting a bit sleepy... th-this is training too, right?
Sylla_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: The target is over there, not here!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Sylla_Skin2: Sylla ambitiously prepared a swimsuit so she could play in the water. On a sweltering summer day, merely sitting beside her brings a gentle, cool breeze.
Sylla_Growth2_Skin2: Entrust your wish to the wind.
Sylla_LevelUp_Skin2: Ah... Could I not rest just a little longer?
Sylla_Equipment_Skin2: Swimming requires more things than one might expect.
Sylla_HeroSkill_Skin2: I can even summon a storm?
Sylla_Touch1_Skin2: Ugh, would you like a taste of the wind?
Sylla_Touch1_2_Skin2: Do it once more and... you know what will happen.
Sylla_Touch2_1_Skin2: You are messing up my hair! ...Not that I dislike it.
Sylla_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: I'm going to throw you into the sea!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Sylla_Skin3: Sylla appears as an elegant conqueror. No one knows what storm the new wind she summons may create.
Sylla_Growth1_Skin3: I have come to conquer this place.
Sylla_Equipment_Skin3: A cutting-edge bow? Have new functions been added?
Sylla_HeroSkill_Skin3: I have grown even stronger. You had best stay alert.
Sylla_Board_Skin3: The wind over there calls to me.
Sylla_Touch1_Skin3: ...I am a little busy right now.
Sylla_Touch1_1_Skin3: I am in the middle of training!
Sylla_Touch1_2_Skin3: You mean to become my enemy?
Sylla_Touch2_Skin3: I was a little tired, but now I feel refreshed.
Sylla_Touch2_1_Skin3: Hah... I feel my fatigue fading away.
Sylla_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: I am Sylla, a high elemental! I am not some being from another dimension!

Aside_Upgrade_Sylla1:
I wish the other guys would grow a little...

Sylla_AsideGet: We were innocent back then. Elves? I do not like them. But I do like their photos.
Sylla_AsideUpgrade: I wish the others would grow a little too. We must not remain trapped in our memories. I will keep growing.

Sylla_SPSkill1-03: Feel the power of the wind!
Sylla_Birthday: My birthday...? You want a present? Be grateful that I am here.
Sylla_Gacha2: Do not underestimate the leader of the high-ranking Elementals.
Sylla_Gacha3: Wherever you may be, the wind blows.
Sylla_Line1: Every last elemental has a screw loose.
Sylla_Line2: If only Elias were a little more peaceful...
Sylla_Line3: That last typhoon? I did not cause it.
Sylla_Lobby: Today is perfect for roaming around.
Sylla_ThemeInteraction01: Ah! Stay away! Laika, I told you to stop!
Sylla_ThemeInteraction02: I have come to my senses, so could you stop now?
Sylla_ThemeInteraction03: I promise to live diligently and stop being lazy, so let me go.
Sylla_ThemeInteraction04: How are you beating the doll?
LoveLetter_Sylla: Master, I hope you got this letter okay. I entrusted it to the wind, so I trust it found its way safely.I'm always grateful to you, Master. I've often seen how considerate you are toward me and the other elementals. It's clear that your efforts have also helped foster better harmony between elementals and other races. As the noble wind elemental, and a representative of our kind, I wanted to extend my gratitude. May a soothing wind grace you today.
LoveCall_Sylla:
It is I, Master.
News of you came upon the wind, so I called. I am glad that you seem to be doing well lately.
I too have been spending peaceful days. I become angry over small matters far less often than before.

There are still those who climb Elemental Mountain and bother me...
But perhaps I have learned, to some degree, how to release negative feelings into the wind.

It is all thanks to you. Thank you for caring for Elias and we Elementals as its Master.
Whenever you need my help, call me.
It would be even better if you came to visit Elemental Mountain while you are at it.

Ahem, no. Forget what I just said.
I shall end the call... Until we meet again, Master.
Affinity_Sylla_EP01_001: Things look busy in the banquet hall. Is there anything I can help with?
Affinity_Sylla_EP01_002: There's no air conditioning when it's hot. Be our air conditioner.
Affinity_Sylla_EP01_003: Air... What? I don't know what you're talking about, but I somehow feel offended.
Affinity_Sylla_EP01_004: I appreciate the thought. Please don't worry and enjoy yourself.
Affinity_Sylla_EP01_005: It's good to see you working so hard. I can't help but feel inclined to help.
Affinity_Sylla_EP01_006: Just don't glare at the phantoms. Fighting isn't allowed in here.
Affinity_Sylla_EP01_007:
What? You're the weird one for being so trusting of phantoms!
Even when they seem trustworthy, you still need to keep an eye on them!
Affinity_Sylla_EP02_001:
It's refreshing to come down after living atop a mountain all the time.
Are there any activities you'd recommend?
Affinity_Sylla_EP02_003:
I've been there. It is quite popular.
However, the owner got mad at me when I went through the checkout,
saying something about a magic school.
Affinity_Sylla_EP02_004: Throw tomatoes at Erpin. She's standing there as punishment.
Affinity_Sylla_EP02_005:
Did she run away again...? She's a real piece of work.
I wonder when the Sprite Queen will come to her senses...
Affinity_Sylla_EP02_006: I think I saw some of your arrows at Mayo's pawnshop.
Affinity_Sylla_EP02_007: What?! A bunch went missing a few days ago and that's where they were?!
Affinity_Sylla_EP03_001: Is anyone causing mischief in Elias these days?
Affinity_Sylla_EP03_003: They're just kids playing around, what harm could they possibly do?
Affinity_Sylla_EP03_005: The elves? Again? I'd better go teach them a lesson now.
Affinity_Sylla_EP03_006: I haven't heard anything unusual lately.
Affinity_Sylla_EP03_007: Even the phantoms? Urgh... It's always so unsettling when things are peaceful.
Affinity_Sylla_EP04_001: The banquet hall always seems full of worshippers. Do you have a favorite?
Affinity_Sylla_EP04_003:
I thought so. Tell me who it is.
Don't worry, I won't spread it through the winds.
Affinity_Sylla_EP04_005:
You don't? Really? How is that possible?
You love everyone the same way, is that it? How dull.
Affinity_Sylla_EP04_007: Wh-Wh-What? Stop messing with me! Not just anyone can become the master of the wind!
Affinity_Sylla_EP05_001:
I once heard in passing that you shouldn't break wind...
But what did they mean by that? Is it a bad thing?
Affinity_Sylla_EP05_003: Why the hesitation? Is it something that bad?
Affinity_Sylla_EP05_004: When you break wind, the smaller winds blow everything away...?
Affinity_Sylla_EP05_005: So it's good since you can even spread seeds, then, right?
Affinity_Sylla_EP05_006: It's not bad when you're alone and it helps prevent discomfort...
Affinity_Sylla_EP05_007: It helps prevent discomfort...? I'm not sure exactly what you mean, but it sounds wonderful... This is confusing.
Affinity_Sylla_EP06_001:
I was skeptical when you said you serve food to elementals...
but this isn't so bad after all...
Affinity_Sylla_EP06_003:
Well, we don't actually eat food...
But, I guess you can "feel" the vibe somehow? Something like that.
Affinity_Sylla_EP06_004: How does an elemental's digestive system work?
Affinity_Sylla_EP06_005: Are you asking me to open my gut up and show you how it works or something? Do you think I would do something so embarrassing?
Affinity_Sylla_EP06_006: Taste is one thing, but ambiance plays a part too.
Affinity_Sylla_EP06_007:
It definitely does. I get to meet others too...
It's kinda lonely at the top of Elemental Mountain.
Affinity_Sylla_EP07_001: Urgh... Shaydi has tricked me again! She'll pay for this!
Affinity_Sylla_EP07_003:
She lured me to a windmill and made me turn it!
The windmill flew into the air and crashed into Sprite Palace!
Affinity_Sylla_EP07_004: Can't you be friends with Shaydi?
Affinity_Sylla_EP07_005: How can I be friends with someone who plays weird pranks on me every day?!
Affinity_Sylla_EP07_006: Maybe phantoms and elementals need to be separated.
Affinity_Sylla_EP07_007:
Y-Yes! I'd rather not run into any phantoms when I'm at the Order!
You'll do that for me, won't you?
Affinity_Sylla_EP08_001:
Ifrit and I made a bet to get a passing sprite to take off her coat.
Guess who won?
Affinity_Sylla_EP08_003: You think I lost to Ifrit? What do you take me for?
Affinity_Sylla_EP08_005: I created a strong blast of wind that blew the sprite away... but I couldn't get her coat off.
Affinity_Sylla_EP08_006: I bet it was a losing bet for both of you.
Affinity_Sylla_EP08_007:
Correct. Elementals don't care who the strongest is.
I'm sure I'm a bit stronger, though.
Affinity_Sylla_EP09_001: Do you want to know what those sprites are whispering at that table over there?
Affinity_Sylla_EP09_002: Hmm... are they saying bad things about me?
Affinity_Sylla_EP09_003: You're way too paranoid, Master. You should learn to trust others.
Affinity_Sylla_EP09_005: If that's what you want to believe, I suppose it wouldn't hurt...
Affinity_Sylla_EP09_007: Not quite. But don't be too surprised if some of the food disappears. *Chuckle*
Affinity_Sylla_EP10_001: As a wind elemental, I've witnessed many things. It's exhausting sometimes.
Affinity_Sylla_EP10_002: Have you seen natural disasters or something?
Affinity_Sylla_EP10_003: Sigh... Why does nature destroy itself sometimes? Isn't that odd?
Affinity_Sylla_EP10_004: Have you seen some rousing fights or something?
Affinity_Sylla_EP10_005: Why so excited? It's nothing enjoyable.
Affinity_Sylla_EP10_006: Still, it can't be all bad, right?
Affinity_Sylla_EP10_007: Yes, that's true, too. For every bad in this world, there must also be something, good, right? That's a good way to think.
Affinity_Sylla_EP11_001: Wouldn't it be good if the banquet hall had at least some basic rules and order? What do you think?
Affinity_Sylla_EP11_002: Why? Did you run into phantoms again?
Affinity_Sylla_EP11_003: You know me well. Every time I run into one it's just such a pain.
Affinity_Sylla_EP11_004: Isn't this good enough? I wouldn't call this a lawless wasteland.
Affinity_Sylla_EP11_005: Hmm... That's true, but still... Something feels a bit lacking, you know.
Affinity_Sylla_EP11_006: I don't like that kind of hassle. It's all up to the owner—me!
Affinity_Sylla_EP11_007: Tsk. You clearly don't have what it takes to run this place. That's all the more reason to stay on top of things.
Affinity_Sylla_EP12_001: The wind must never stop... but sometimes I find myself wanting to linger in this place.
Affinity_Sylla_EP12_002: It's okay to take a break sometimes.
Affinity_Sylla_EP12_003: Thank you. Still, I can't stay too long.
Affinity_Sylla_EP12_004: Is it because the food is so delicious?
Affinity_Sylla_EP12_005: Hmm... Well. I think it's comfortable in many ways.
Affinity_Sylla_EP12_006: Just don't make the other customers feel uncomfortable.
Affinity_Sylla_EP12_007: I'm not making anyone uncomfortable. I'm just correcting them to maintain proper etiquette!
Affinity_Sylla_EP13_001: The laughter carried by the wind from this place always lifts my spirits.
Affinity_Sylla_EP13_002: Huh? You can hear that all the way to the Elemental Mountain?
Affinity_Sylla_EP13_003: The wind blows everywhere. And I don't always stay on the Elemental Mountain, so of course I hear things.
Affinity_Sylla_EP13_004: Huh... Nobody laughed in the banquet hall today though... Could it be?
Affinity_Sylla_EP13_005: Hmph, then those little phantoms must have been up to their tricks again... What? You were the one joking?
Affinity_Sylla_EP13_006: That's kind of scary. I should watch what I say from now on.
Affinity_Sylla_EP13_007: I don't chase every whisper carried by the wind. But caution never hurt anyone.
Affinity_Sylla_EP14_001: What are you thinking about? The air feels a bit heavy today.
Affinity_Sylla_EP14_003: Call it instinct, but I tend to be right.
Affinity_Sylla_EP14_004: If the air has gotten heavier, what does that say about you?
Affinity_Sylla_EP14_005: I just meant th-the air feels heavy—b-big deal! It's not such a big deal!!
Affinity_Sylla_EP14_006: You showing up helped lighten my mood a bit.
Affinity_Sylla_EP14_007: Hehe. That's kind of you to say. The air probably actually got a little lighter too.
Affinity_Sylla_EP15_001: Lately I've been thinking we need to reorganize the hierarchy of the elementals once again.
Affinity_Sylla_EP15_003: I've never been that strict with the elementals. All I have done has been for their own good!
Affinity_Sylla_EP15_004: How are you planning to reorganize things?
Affinity_Sylla_EP15_005: Hmm... I suppose we need to establish a clear hierarchy, starting with the lower elementals.
Affinity_Sylla_EP15_006: Aren't you just fanning the flames of discord?
Affinity_Sylla_EP15_007: Discord? Any elemental should be able to endure a certain level of criticism and discipline.
Affinity_Sylla_EP16_001: Why are so many people interested in my arrows? They're nothing particularly special.
Affinity_Sylla_EP16_002: Because they're all sparkly and shiny.
Affinity_Sylla_EP16_003: Really, that's why? There are plenty of other shiny things around.
Affinity_Sylla_EP16_004: Maybe they want to get hit by one?
Affinity_Sylla_EP16_005: That can't be it. Even if that were the case, my arrows aren't meant to be wasted on childish games.
Affinity_Sylla_EP16_006: They certainly look impressive enough from over here.
Affinity_Sylla_EP16_007: Hmm. Is that so? If everyone thinks they look good, then I suppose there's no problem... It does make me feel rather pleased.
Affinity_Sylla_EP17_001: Those elves seem to be gradually expanding their territory toward the Elemental Mountain. If this continues, I won't stand for it.
Affinity_Sylla_EP17_002: Maybe you should establish a green belt.
Affinity_Sylla_EP17_003: What? I don't even have pants on, what do I need a belt for?
Affinity_Sylla_EP17_004: Let me go talk to them about it.
Affinity_Sylla_EP17_005: Hmm... I'd appreciate that. I'm not really fond of conflict to be honest.
Affinity_Sylla_EP17_006: Wouldn't it be good for both sides to compromise and work things out together.
Affinity_Sylla_EP17_007: Why should the victim have to compromise too? Just giving in all the time doesn't solve anything.
Affinity_Sylla_EP18_001: It feels like you always treat me well. Is there anything I can do to return the favor?
Affinity_Sylla_EP18_002: How about you bring us a refreshing breeze from time to time.
Affinity_Sylla_EP18_003: I can definitely do that! What a relief to have found a way to repay you somehow.
Affinity_Sylla_EP18_004: Would you put an apple on your head and lend me your bow?
Affinity_Sylla_EP18_005: Uh, huh? What are you trying to do? Huh? Hey! Stop that right now!
Affinity_Sylla_EP18_006: I'm doing it because I like it, so. It's totally fine.
Affinity_Sylla_EP18_007: Is that so? I was trying to do my part, but I guess that didn't work out.
Affinity_Sylla_EP19_001: Have you been to Blanchet's Garden? It's pretty. But I couldn't look around for long.
Affinity_Sylla_EP19_002: Why? It's a pretty and nice place.
Affinity_Sylla_EP19_003: When I get close, the pollen gets really bad. Quite disappointing.
Affinity_Sylla_EP19_004: I've been there. Should we go together next time?
Affinity_Sylla_EP19_005: We'd have to take a quick look and leave because of the pollen, but if that's okay with you...
Affinity_Sylla_EP19_006: Hmm... Going outside Erpien is quite a hassle...
Affinity_Sylla_EP19_007: Hmph! Just try to travel outside sometimes! And here I went through the trouble of bringing it up...!
Affinity_Sylla_EP20_001: I hope Elias stays peaceful and doesn't fall into chaos.
Affinity_Sylla_EP20_003: Yeah. For that to happen, everyone will need to work together.
Affinity_Sylla_EP20_004: Well. Who knows how that'll go?
Affinity_Sylla_EP20_005: Uhm... Shouldn't you as the Master have a plan?
Affinity_Sylla_EP20_006: Wouldn't it be boring if things were too peaceful?
Affinity_Sylla_EP20_007: That doesn't mean we can invite chaos. What do you think comes first, fun or order?
